points.description: Identifies the appetitive faculty as one of the divisions/parts of the soul (Plato's tripartite theory of the soul).
points.partial_credit: Half if it only mentions the soul or Plato without saying it is a part/division.

points.description: States that it deals with desires, passions, appetites or bodily urges (e.g. hunger, thirst, pleasure).
points.partial_credit: Half if wording is vague, e.g. 'feelings' or 'wants'.

rubric.notes: Full marks for saying it is a part of the soul (Plato) and that it concerns desires/passions, in any wording. Give part marks if only one idea is given or both are vague. Give zero for unrelated or wrong answers, such as naming the reason or spirit part only. Extra remarks do not cost marks unless they contradict the main idea.
